results.evidence_text: We also observed a weaker but significant negative association of black tea intake and prostate cancer incidence (P = 0.020).
results.manual_review_reason: Abstract reports only a P value and direction for the prostate cancer association; no numeric RR is given, so the Claude+Gemini value 0.6 cannot be confirmed or rejected from title/abstract/MeSH.
results.one_sentence_explanation: The abstract states a significant negative association of black tea with prostate cancer incidence (P = 0.020) but gives no numeric effect size, so the claimed RR of 0.6 can neither be supported nor refuted.
